// 反向 fixture：业务模块不得出现的 runtime 私有知识（架构守卫必须抓到这里）。
// 本文件不会被编译/执行，只被 architecture-boundaries.test.ts 当普通文本扫描。
// 同时覆盖 review 指出的漏网形态：别名接收者、解构、模板插值、引号比较、
// 业务侧现场构造 RuntimeAccess。
import type { RuntimeFacade } from '../../src/runtime/runtime-facade';

export function businessLeak(runtime: RuntimeFacade, facade: any) {
  const wantsDiff = runtime?.capabilities?.diffApi;
  const wantsTree = (runtime as any)['capabilities'].worktreeApi;
  const isPi = (runtime as any).name === 'pi';
  const isClaude = runtime.name === 'claude';
  const label = runtime?.activeDialect;
  const completion = (runtime as any).completion;
  const credentials = runtime.credentials;
  const spawn = runtime.agentProcess.spawnServe;
  const baseUrl = runtime.getBaseUrl();
  const healthy = runtime.healthCheck();
  const cfg = runtime.config.get();

  // 组合根不允许的 getter 形态：把诊断字段重新挂回门面。
  Object.defineProperty(facade, 'capabilities', { get: () => runtime.capabilities });

  // runtime 私有存储布局。
  const snapshotRoot = `${process.env.HOME}/.local/share/opencode/snapshot`;

  return { wantsDiff, wantsTree, isPi, isClaude, label, completion, credentials, spawn, baseUrl, healthy, cfg, snapshotRoot };
}

export function runtimeNameBranch(runtimeName: string) {
  return runtimeName === 'pi' ? 'in-process' : 'serve';
}

// ── review 漏网形态（别名 / 解构 / 插值 / 引号比较 / 现场构造 access）──
export function aliasedLeaks(client: any, runtimeClient: any, deps: any) {
  const viaCall = deps.getRuntime()?.capabilities;
  const viaClient = client.capabilities;
  const viaRuntimeClient = runtimeClient.capabilities;
  const { capabilities } = client;
  const inTemplate = `${client.capabilities.diffApi}`;
  const viaClientConfig = client.config.get();
  const viaClientCompletion = runtimeClient.completion;
  const isPiByAlias = client.name === 'pi';
  const access = new RuntimeAccess(client);
  return { viaCall, viaClient, viaRuntimeClient, capabilities, inTemplate, viaClientConfig, viaClientCompletion, isPiByAlias, access };
}
